# ADR-3259: AWS root_mfa: Daily root console usage for account 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Routine root use expands exposure.

## Decision

Teams MUST NOT rely on daily root console usage for account 3 (AWS-root_mfa-3).

## Consequences

Delegated admin roles replace root tasks.
